tagline: DuckDB and MotherDuck analytics for remote teammates — queries can write files.
requirements: Set MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN in the host environment to reach MotherDuck cloud databases; without a token the server opens local DuckDB files. This is the official server from MotherDuck. Point it only at databases whose contents may be disclosed.

tools.name: switch_database_connection
tools.note: Attaches a different database, including local files by path.

tools.name: execute_query
tools.note: Runs arbitrary SQL — DuckDB statements can write files and mutate local databases.

seo.description: Share the official MotherDuck MCP server with MCPWire. Point the host at your DuckDB or MotherDuck data, let teammates explore schemas over P2P, and keep query runs behind approval.
